reviews.x: I am very disturbed over this distributors quality control. The product i received was what appears to be typical hand soap. I have used this product for years( my dermatologist recommended)  because of a serious reaction my skin has to perfumes and artificial additives. I had a serious reaction to these ingredients.

I have pretty tough/tolerant skin and this was waaaayyyyy too strong for me! My skin was very dry and irritated after only one use.  The bottle does say recommended to remove makeu, Im sure it would do a good job with that because its ssstttrrronnngg!!

reviews.t: Too harsh for NOT OILY skin
reviews.x: This cleanser is too drying for my skin. After one use my face is red and irritated from being to dry.  It feels like it is sunburned. I do not have oily skin, but more combination...to maybe a wee dry.  The description of the product on the page here on Amazon states is it good for all skin types.  However, when I received my bottle of cleanser I read that it was for oily skin types but good for combination too.  I wonder if I had oily skin it would not be so drying....I would like to have know

Nothing special. I want to start off by saying I LOVE LOVE LOVE their sunscreens and I wanted to love this cleanser..... but my experience with it was meh. Didn't smell nice, didn't do anything for my acne (although it never claims to help with acne), and didn't leave my skin looking or feeling wonderful.  I love treating myself with skincare products that make me love the process. They might change the product in the future but I honestly believe you can find yourself a more effective cleanser

I suffer from adult acne, and had a HUGE acne meltdown over the spring... it was so disheartening. I turned to eltaMD deep pore cleanser to get relief from the redness, bumps, and breakouts. Worked the first day!! Instantly calmed my breakout down and cleared my skin up. I recommend for all acne sufferers!

I wear heavy liquid foundation every day, so I need something really powerful at night to take off my makeup. This is hands down the best product I've used for makeup removal. A half pump will take off about 90% of my makeup and the rest (mostly around the eyes) I'll wipe off with a facial cloth. I'd expect a product like this to retail at $50, so while $20 is kind of expensive, it's worth it and will last me around 3 months.

I REALLY like the product in the left, but accidentally ordered the product in the right. It seems that Elta could do more to distinguish between it's cleansers. The one on the left is MUCH more gentle - it does not strip my skin of all it's natural moisture, which is critical for my combination skin!

I first got introduced to EltaMD at this spa where I would get my microdermabrasion treatments 3 years ago, and I am glad I did. They are not too expensive (for me), and work so good on your skin. This face wash lathers well on my clarisonic brush and has a low, clean scent, almost none actually..I have decent combination skin, prone to white heads, and this works great for my skin type, my husband has clear more dry skin and it works fantastic on him too..I recommend this product and any other

claims.text: Several reviewers believe they received a counterfeit product that looks and smells like hand soap rather than the real cleanser.
Some users report the cleanser is too drying and irritating, causing redness and flaking even after one use.
Positive reviewers praise it as an effective acne cleanser and makeup remover that calms breakouts and removes heavy makeup.
Some customers find the product unremarkable, with an unpleasant scent and no noticeable benefit.
A few reviewers note confusion between EltaMD's different cleansers, with some finding this one harsher than the gentler foaming version.
